en: Now, just as with GitHub Copilot, you can
also use the cursor chat here in the
terminal to generate terminal commands. So
commands that are ran in the command line.
For example,
initialize as a Git repo.
If I hit Enter,
it puts git init into the terminal.
So you can use human language to describe
commands you want to execute.
And you can then reject or
press Escape to accept and close it but not
execute it. Or you could have picked Run to
run the command right away.
So that's another very neat feature which
kind of also existed in Visual Studio Code
with GitHub Copilot, of course,
but it also exists here in Cursor. You can
build and run commands with your natural
language through this feature by pressing
this shortcut here to generate a command in
the terminal right here inside of Cursor.
